rules.what_counts: Human inputs = (a) user entries with origin.kind=='human' (typed at the prompt or delivered via the queue from Remote Control); (b) queued_command attachments with origin.kind=='human' (messages sent while the agent was working and absorbed mid-turn; timestamp = when sent, absorbed_mid_turn_at = when the agent saw them); (c) local slash commands (/remote-control, /mcp, /permissions); (d) the AskUserQuestion answers; (e) the one Esc interrupt; (f) the owner's messages from a published page's Talk tab (spacesheep Talk), relayed as monitor task notifications whose event has spacesheep_talk true and is from the account owner, counted once per message id. Excluded: tool results, other task notifications, agent-to-agent (peer) messages, system reminders, compaction summaries, isMeta injections. No 'user sent a new message while you were working' tool-result text exists in this transcript; mid-turn messages appear only as queued_command attachments.
rules.timestamp: For queued prompts, the matching queue-operation enqueue time (= send time); otherwise the entry time.
rules.typing_s: max(10 s, chars / 200 chars-per-minute); interrupt = 2 s; images not counted.
rules.talk: a Talk message is credited no reading time (it is written on a page, not after reading the session)
rules.read_s: words of the latest assistant message (by message.id) containing text that finished before the input, / 250 wpm, capped at 10 min; each assistant message is credited to at most one human input (no double counting); for the AskUserQuestion answer, the words of the question and options.
rules.active_s_paste_adjusted: same, but likely-pasted inputs (over 2000 chars, plus two shorter ones that are a template and pasted terminal output) have typing capped at 3 min
rules.engagement_sessions: runs of inputs with gaps < 30 min; start_est = first input time minus that input's active_s; end = last input time
rules.summaries: hand-written, <= 12 words, no names of other people, credentials or access paths
